topicName: engagement patterns in physical activity and sport

steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Engagement patterns: The ways in which different groups of people participate (or don't participate) in physical activity and sport. These patterns vary significantly based on personal, social and cultural factors. | Key Point: The process of socialisation means that children learn attitudes and behaviours from their family. A child raised in a sporty family is far more likely to participate in sport than one whose family has no interest in physical activity. This influence is especially strong in early childhood. | PE Exam Tips — Engagement Patterns in Physical Activity and Sport: 1. For Engagement Patterns in Physical Activity and Sport questions, use subject-specific terminology precisely 2. Support every point with specific evidence or examples 3. Show balanced analysis — consider diff

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain how gender stereotyping can limit participation in sport for both males and females. | Describe how religion can be a barrier to participation in sport and suggest how this barrier could be overcome. | Explain the term 'socialisation' and how family influences can affect a young person's participation in sport.
